subject: lean ninja in a black shinobi outfit with a red sash and mask, katana in the right hand
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a small dust puff on take-off and on landing

plan.source: Three-quarter facing screen-right in a wide low guard; right hand holds katana low and forward near the lead right foot, left hand open back by hip; head turned right; right foot forward, left foot back, both planted.

frames.pose: Anticipation: sink deeper, torso leans slightly forward; right hand lowers blade further forward/down; left hand reaches slightly forward; head dips, eyes to right; knees load, heels heavy; right foot leads, both feet firmly planted.
Takeoff: legs drive and hips whip back; torso snaps up then back; right arm sweeps katana up past shoulder; left arm throws down/back; head starts to tilt back into flip; toes leave together.
frames.effect: small dust puffs at both toe takeoff points; bright arc tracing blade from low-front to above-shoulder

frames.pose: Apex key: fully inverted, torso tucked; knees to chest; right hand tucks katana across body, blade pointing left; left hand near knee for balance; head upside-down facing right.

Descent: rotate toward upright; torso untucks, chest forward; right leg extends down to meet ground, left leg trailing; right arm lets blade sweep down/front; left hand forward for balance; head realigns to right.
frames.effect: short faint trail behind blade’s downward sweep

frames.pose: Landing and recover: both feet plant, knees bent to absorb; weight forward into guard; right hand lowers katana toward original low line; left hand opens back by hip; head steady to right.
frames.effect: small dust puffs at both heels on impact
